$comment: Brand colors per product (project). Each entry becomes a [data-product="<id>"] block in dist/css/tokens.css
(see scripts/build-products.mts). 'palette' is the product's base color family in src/color-tokens.css
(--<palette>-50 ... -900, from the Figma Color System page); the PartoBita brand aliases (--background-brand-*,
--text-brand, --border-brand-*, ...) point at it. 'primary', 'secondary' and 'tertiary' are the seed colors of
the Material 3 color roles: a base color token name (without the leading --) or a hex color. Secondary and
tertiary are optional; Angular Material derives them from the primary seed when they are missing. 'dark' holds
optional seeds for dark themes; without it the dark roles come from the same seeds. 'aliases' are extra
data-product values that select the same brand. 'default' marks the brand of the PartoBita aliases when no
data-product is set (the Material roles then stay those of the data-theme).
